label: accepted

evidence.V1: Squat bulged barrel with two dark hoops reads instantly in front, three-quarter, top and silhouette; outline is mirror-symmetric (A15 X/Y error 0.0) and seated on its base.
evidence.V2: Clear big/medium/small: bulged stave body, two thick iron hoops with a rim lip, small hex nails at four points per hoop.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportion: wide squat belly with strong taper to a rolled rim, chunky oversized hoops.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on hoop edges (bright specular line) and rolled stave rim; nails bevelled; no razor or blobby edges.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean smooth shading, but the inner rim edge is wobbly/jagged in the top view and lid close-up (uneven stave steps around the opening).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one wood hue in light/mid/dark stave values plus ink-dark iron; colourways swap only the hue.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, ink-dark kit metal, wood hue, ~kit chamfer and smooth shading; matches the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Irregular, jagged inner rim outline around the barrel opening (visible in top view and lid close-up)
top_fixes: Make the inner rim edge a clean even ring (uniform stave inset depth) so the opening outline is not wobbly
Optionally add a little more value contrast between alternating staves on the body to strengthen the stave read at small sizes
